nt2e01.title: Things that make sense: cold nights
nt2e01.caption: Cold nights have a system: blankets, soup, and one Capricorn carrying a spare scarf just in case. Who in your life always has the extra layer?

nt2e02.title: Things that make sense: texting
nt2e02.caption: A proofread "on my way.", three voice notes in a row, and a "home safe?" at 11 PM that gets a yes in two seconds. Which texter are you?

nt2e03.title: Things that make sense: first dates
nt2e03.caption: Leo shows up with a compliment loaded, Sag swaps dinner for a walk, and Libra picks the place in one second because Libra asked what you like first.

nt2e04.title: Things that make sense: party season
nt2e04.caption: Party season, sorted: Aries opens the dance floor, Gemini knows every name by nine, and Capricorn has both coats ready the second you say you're tired.

nt2e05.title: Things that make sense: love languages
nt2e05.caption: Taurus pushes the biggest snack your way. Aries wins the race to the car, then holds the door. Virgo fixes the squeaky door and never mentions it. Which one have you dated?

nt2e06.title: Unpopular opinion: plans are romantic
nt2e06.caption: Capricorn said planning a date is romantic and the crowd gasped. Then Sagittarius pulled out a colour-coded planner. Team spontaneous or team Saturday at seven?

nt2e07.title: Unpopular opinion: "I'm not sure yet"
nt2e07.caption: Libra climbed onto a crate to defend "I'm not sure yet" and somehow Taurus ended up in tears. An honest maybe beats a rushed yes.

nt2e08.title: Unpopular opinion: the same movie again
nt2e08.caption: Taurus says rewatching the same comfort movie is a perfect date. Ten seconds later the whole crowd was on the couch. What's the movie you'd rewatch forever?

nt2e09.title: Unpopular opinion: early nights
nt2e09.caption: Virgo, in a nightcap, defending the home-by-ten date. Even Sagittarius yawned and agreed. Early nights are underrated and we will not be taking questions.

nt2e10.title: Unpopular opinion: "what are we?"
nt2e10.caption: Scorpio calmly says asking "what are we?" isn't scary, and the crush in the crowd raises a hand. Would you ask first, or wait to be asked?

nt2e11.title: Soft launch vs hard launch: telling the friends
nt2e11.caption: Gemini went from "met someone… anyway" to a thirty-slide presentation. The friends already had a banner made. The group chat always knows first.

nt2e12.title: Soft launch vs hard launch: meet the family
nt2e12.caption: Cancer slipped an extra plate onto the table "for a friend". Turns out Mom set that place ages ago, cushion and all. Who's bringing someone home this year?

nt2e13.title: Soft launch vs hard launch: "I like you"
nt2e13.caption: Aries tried "you're cool, I guess", then a giant banner, then finally put both down and said it quietly, face to face. Guess which one worked.

nt2e14.title: Soft launch vs hard launch: the group photo
nt2e14.caption: Libra takes everyone's holiday photo and never ends up in one. This year the friends pulled them into the frame. Who's the photographer in your group?

nt2e15.title: Soft launch vs hard launch: the nickname
nt2e15.caption: Capricorn tried "hey… you", then a cake iced MY SWEETPEA, then simply asked what they like to be called. The answer was sweeter than the cake.

nt2e16.title: Delulu or solulu: they laughed at my joke
nt2e16.caption: Two laughs and one "you're funny" and Leo had the meter pinned on delulu. Then Leo asked about Friday. What's the smallest sign you've ever over-read?

nt2e17.title: Delulu or solulu: "see you around"
nt2e17.caption: "See you around" had Pisces planning a whole future, and crying about it, obviously. One brave question later, around means Saturday.

nt2e18.title: Delulu or solulu: we both like hiking
nt2e18.caption: Same trail, same snack, same sunrise photo, and Sagittarius had already called it fate. One question did more than fate ever could. Snacks are non-negotiable.

nt2e19.title: Delulu or solulu: they held the door
nt2e19.caption: They held the door and Cancer was ready to bring out the family photo album. Then Cancer asked about coffee and got a real yes. Manners are a start, not a proposal.

nt2e20.title: Delulu or solulu: a follow-up question
nt2e20.caption: Aquarius read two follow-up questions as destiny, asked about a date, and got "as friends? I'd love that!" Still a win: now Aquarius knows, and it made a friend.
